0022600098.text: The Pistons, who are 1-0 and sit 1st in the Central and 2nd in the East, visit the Heat (0-1, 5th in the Southeast and 14th in the East) in the second game of Detroit's season. Detroit has yet to play a road game this season, while Miami is also winless at home so far. Detroit lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, most recently 121-110 in Miami on March 8, 2026, and this will be the first meeting between the teams this season.
